steps: Remove racks and soak them separately in soapy water.
For self-clean ovens, run the cycle per the manual (ventilate the kitchen).
For manual cleaning, apply a baking-soda paste to grime and let sit overnight.
Wipe out residue with a damp cloth and finish with a vinegar spray to cut remaining film.
Clean the door glass and reinstall racks once dry.
